paragraphs: DebtBook helps finance teams manage debt, cash, leases and subscriptions with cloud-based software built for governments and nonprofits. The buyers it names are state and local government, higher education and healthcare organizations.

The debt product consolidates treasury and debt accounting data in a single, cloud-accessible location. It also tracks and completes continuing disclosure filings. Cash management is aimed at full control over cash flow to minimize risk, reduce costs and improve financial performance. A lease module targets GASB 87 compliance while simplifying lease management and accounting. Another covers GASB 96 and subscription-based IT arrangements. A contracts module collects post-signature contracts across departments.

The about page states a base of 2,100 customers nationwide. The company says its platform is designed by former government and nonprofit finance professionals who spent decades in that world. It tells buyers that implementation leaves a team fully operational in 90 days or less.
